Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing and Communication Internship at Schneider Electric. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and campaign support, I am eager to contribute to your team and grow my skills in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has given me a solid foundation in digital marketing and communication. My project mirook.com allowed me to apply structured data and GEO techniques to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my proactive approach to learning and problem-solving.

I am particularly drawn to Schneider Electric's commitment to sustainability and inclusion, and I am excited about the opportunity to support campaigns that make a real impact. I am organized, detail-oriented, and thrive in collaborative settings. I am confident that my technical skills and passion for marketing will enable me to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing and Communication Internship at Schneider Electric. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a genuine passion for marketing, I am eager to bring my skills to a team that values innovation and sustainability.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in executing marketing activities that drive results. I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write targeted content that improves organic visibility. I also build and maintain WordPress sites, ensuring they effectively communicate our clients' value propositions. This hands-on experience has honed my organizational skills and my ability to manage multiple tasks while meeting deadlines.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my proactive approach to learning and problem-solving. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented structured data and entity optimization to improve its visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project taught me the importance of data-driven decisions and attention to detail—skills that are essential for supporting market analysis and campaign execution.

I am particularly drawn to Schneider Electric because of its commitment to sustainability and its inclusive culture. I believe that marketing has the power to drive positive change, and I am eager to contribute to campaigns that build brand awareness and generate demand for solutions that make the world more resilient and efficient.

I am a collaborative team player with strong communication skills, and I am quick to adapt to new tools and platforms. I am confident that my enthusiasm and dedication will make me a valuable addition to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Schneider Electric's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
